Title: NETMESSAGE:Damn, this barricade was built much \n stronger than the others were
Translation: 该死，这道路障建得比别人\n坚固多了

Title: NETMESSAGE:- So what? Are we trapped here then?
Translation: - 那又怎样？我们被困在这里了？

Title: NETMESSAGE:We need some time to - Hey whassat noise?
Translation: 我们需要点时间——嘿，那是什么声音？

Title: NETMESSAGE:It sounded like something squeaking...
Translation: 听起来像是有什么东西在吱吱叫...

Title: NETMESSAGE:OWWW! That thing took a chunk outta me!
Translation: 嗷！那东西咬掉了我一块肉！

Title: NETMESSAGE:We're going to have to break that barricade \n if we're going to get out of this
Translation: 我们得打破那道路障\n才能离开这里

Title: NETMESSAGE:- What the hell was that thing?
NETMESSAGE:I don't give a crap what it was. \n Look what it did to my arm!
Translation: 我才不管它是什么。\n看看它对我的胳膊做了什么！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Well, at least that took care of the barricade for us
Translation: 好吧，至少那帮我们把路障解决了
